messages:
sam wang: Heads up — prepping the release notes and internal announce for tonight's deploy (change window 23:00-01:00 PT). Draft below — can someone quick-check pin/version + rollback phrasing? @lina @marco @ops-oncall

lina: On it. Which model/runtime are we pinning?

sam wang: Pinning api-model v2.4.1 (quantized shim). If canary fails, auto-fallback to v2.4.0; rolling back means `redwood rollback --to v2.4.0`. Need concise wording for comms.

marco: Looks good. Suggest adding estimated impact: <1% error increase in worst-case, 5–10ms latency improvement. Also call out canary window 30m on dedicated.

jen: Draft edit suggestion: "If you see elevated errors, ops will rollback to v2.4.0; no customer-visible config changes." Also add oncall handoff: @ops-oncall will monitor first 2 hours.

ops-oncall: I'll take handoff. I'll post a short checklist in #eng-oncall before cut. Can we add the runbook link? https://internal/runbooks/release-2909

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sam at 2026-03-20T23:00:00-07:00 to prod.eng-us. Canary: 2 nodes for 30m. Version pinned: api-model@v2.4.1. Rollback hook: enabled.

sam wang: Copied — final commit to RN doc is below. Please react :thumbsup: if OK, otherwise reply with changes. I'll post internal announce at 22:45.

sam wang: ```
Release notes (internal):
- api: model v2.4.1 (quantized) — improves latency 5–10ms
- Fix: token cache eviction bug under heavy burst
- Note: pinned to v2.4.1; fallback -> v2.4.0
Change window: 23:00-01:00 PT
Canary: 30m on 2 nodes
Rollback: auto on healthcheck fail; ops manual rollback available
```

lina: :thumbsup: all good from infra.

marco: One nit: change 'manual or auto' -> 'auto on healthcheck fail; ops retains manual rollback rights' (matches RN now).

jen: LGTM

sam wang: :thumbsup: thanks — I'm posting the internal announcement and handing off to @ops-oncall for monitoring.
